Done! I added two methods to the `Ledger` class:

1. **`post_end_of_day(account, amount, day: date) -> Entry`** — Posts an entry at 23:59:59 UTC of the given day by combining the date with end-of-day time and delegating to the existing `post` method.

2. **`entries_since(since: datetime) -> list[Entry]`** — Returns all entries posted at or after the given datetime, sorted by posting time (oldest first) using a simple filter and sort.

Both methods reuse existing functionality where possible: `post_end_of_day` uses the `post` method to maintain consistency, and both methods work with the existing `Entry` and `Ledger` structures. All existing tests pass.
